statuses.NOT_VERIFIED: No current exact-SHA evidence collected for the claim.

confirmed_structural_findings.finding: Active public exports include atcfs, vfs, security, ipc, process, scheduler, memory_manager, userspace and syscall; allocator and lkm are cfg(test) in the inspected source.
Boot path imports and initializes AtcFileSystem and Vfs; it also initializes process, scheduler, IPC and broad SecurityManager.
The content-ID helper is explicitly documented as a simplified deterministic hash, with a comment that production requires a real SHA3-256 implementation.
Direct dependency on shivacore kernel crate remains.
Service Space exports AI, network, blockchain, consensus, VM, identity, remote-capability and audit modules.
Versioned ABI and wire-safe syscall/capability types exist; existence does not prove end-to-end runtime isolation.

Direct kernel-crate imports remain: atcnet imports shivacore::ats1000::NetworkStack; remote_caps imports shivacore::capability::Rights; p2p_secure imports shivacore::security::TokenBucket; knowledge_graph imports CapId, CapabilityTable, Pid, ResourceType and Rights. service_init mentions KernelState::boot in comments but no active call was identified in that file. Several hash-dependent service modules already use libshivacore::simple_hash; that function is explicitly non-cryptographic.
